sentences.text:
This civil revision has been preferred by the petitioner under Section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure, against the order dated 08.04.2024 passed in MACC No.209/2023 by IX Member,
MACT, District Ujjain, whereby claim of the respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed on 18.04.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 15.09.2022 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in MACC No.209/2023.
4.

I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:25390 2 CR-878-2024 the record.

5. In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
6.
With the aforesaid observations, this petition is disposed off.

(ALOK AWASTHI) JUDGE Vindesh Bajaj Allianz General Insurance ... vs Deepak S/O Surendra Singh Through ... on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127141103/
